The app provides athletes and their teams with easy access to important information on drug formulation and anti-doping rules for prohibited substances in sport. In this way, the app promotes clean sport and helps protect athletes' health. Moreover, the app helps to prevent unintentional anti-doping rule violations.Main features of the app:

- Information on medicinal products: The app allows users to instantly get information about any medicinal product or active substance registered in the Czech Republic. Users can find out whether a medicinal product or active substance is authorised for use in an out-of-competition or in-competition period.

- Medication tracking: Users can save selected medications and keep track of whether they are on the Prohibited Substances and Methods List.

- News: The app displays news published by the Czech Anti-Doping Committee.

- Important information available: The app contains a signpost to important information related to anti-doping issues, such as the Doping Control Process or the granting of Therapeutic Use Exemptions (TUE).

- Contact experts: Using the app, it is possible to contact experts from the Czech Anti-Doping Committee with questions about prohibited substances, prohibited methods and Therapeutic Use Exemptions (TUE).
